howToPlay: Colette deals more damage to enemies with higher HP. Use your Super to shred through high-health targets and reposition yourself. Use your gadgets to control enemies or stay alive while collecting health taxes.
gears: Use SHIELD to increase survivability while engaging or SPEED to maneuver around the map. DAMAGE is excellent for finishing off targets after dealing percentage-based damage.
trait: Colette suits a strategic player who enjoys countering high-health targets with precise, percentage-based damage.
